title: Door & Trim Carpentry
shortDescription: Professional installation and repair of doors, trim, and finish carpentry with attention to detail and quality materials.
introduction: Our door and trim carpentry services combine precision craftsmanship with quality materials to enhance your home's functionality and aesthetic appeal. From hanging new doors to installing custom trim work, we ensure every detail meets our high standards.
typicalProblems: Doors that don't close properly or stick
Gaps around door frames letting in drafts
Damaged or missing trim and molding
ourApproach: Precise measurements and professional-grade tools for perfect fits
Quality materials that match your existing home style
Clean installation with minimal disruption to your daily routine
Attention to detail in finishing work and paint touch-ups
Hardware upgrades and adjustments for smooth operation

faqs.question: Do you provide the doors and trim materials?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can source high-quality doors, trim, and hardware, or work with materials you've already purchased. We'll discuss options during your estimate.

faqs.question: How long does a typical door installation take?
faqs.answer: Most door installations take 2-4 hours, depending on whether adjustments to the frame are needed. We'll provide a time estimate during your consultation.

faqs.question: Can you match existing trim styles in older homes?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We specialize in matching historical trim profiles and can custom-mill pieces when needed to maintain your home's character.

title: Drywall & Paint Repair
shortDescription: Expert drywall patching, texturing, and paint touch-ups for seamless results that blend perfectly with existing surfaces.
introduction: Our drywall and paint repair services restore your walls to perfect condition with seamless patches and precise color matching. We handle everything from small nail holes to larger damage with professional techniques and quality materials.
typicalProblems: Holes from nails, screws, or accidental damage
Cracks in walls or ceilings from settling
Water damage stains and texture issues
Dents and gouges from furniture or impacts
Poor previous repair work that needs correction
Mismatched paint colors from touch-up attempts
ourApproach: Professional-grade patching compounds and techniques
Precise texture matching for invisible repairs
Color matching service for perfect paint blends
Primer and multi-coat application for durability
Clean work area with plastic sheeting protection

faqs.question: Can you match the exact paint color if I don't have leftover paint?
faqs.answer: Yes, we can color-match from a small sample of your existing paint using professional color matching technology.

faqs.question: How long does drywall repair take to dry?
faqs.answer: Small repairs typically dry in 2-4 hours, while larger patches may need 24 hours before painting. We'll schedule return visits if needed.

faqs.question: Do you handle textured walls and ceilings?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We're experienced with all common textures including orange peel, knockdown, and popcorn ceilings.

title: Fixture Installations
shortDescription: Safe installation of lighting, plumbing fixtures, and home accessories with proper electrical and plumbing connections.
introduction: Our fixture installation services ensure your new lighting, plumbing, and home accessories are installed safely and function perfectly. We handle the technical aspects so you can enjoy your upgraded home features with confidence.
typicalProblems: Bathroom fixtures needing replacement or upgrade
Ceiling fans that wobble or make noise
Kitchen faucets with leaks or poor water pressure
Towel bars, toilet paper holders, and bathroom accessories
ourApproach: Licensed electrical work through trusted partners when required
Proper mounting and secure installation techniques
Water line connections and leak testing for plumbing fixtures
Electrical safety checks and proper grounding
Clean-up and testing of all installed fixtures

faqs.question: Do you handle electrical work for light fixtures?
faqs.answer: We handle basic fixture swaps, but complex electrical work is done through our licensed electrical partners to ensure code compliance.

faqs.question: Can you install fixtures I purchased myself?
faqs.answer: Yes, we're happy to install fixtures you've purchased. We'll verify compatibility and provide warranty on our installation work.

faqs.question: What if my ceiling box won't support a heavy fixture?
faqs.answer: We can install proper bracing or ceiling boxes rated for heavier fixtures to ensure safe installation.

title: Tile & Caulk Repair
shortDescription: Professional tile replacement, grout repair, and caulking services to prevent water damage and maintain bathroom integrity.
introduction: Our tile and caulk repair services protect your bathroom and kitchen from water damage while restoring their clean, finished appearance. We use quality materials and proven techniques for long-lasting results.
typicalProblems: Failed caulk seals around tubs and showers
Soap scum buildup and hard water stains
ourApproach: Complete caulk removal and surface preparation
Professional-grade sealants designed for bathroom use
Tile matching service for seamless repairs
Grout cleaning and sealing for protection
Mildew-resistant materials and techniques

faqs.question: How often should bathroom caulk be replaced?
faqs.answer: Typically every 2-3 years, or sooner if you notice gaps, discoloration, or mildew that won't clean off.

faqs.question: Can you match tiles in older bathrooms?
faqs.answer: We maintain relationships with tile suppliers and can often find close matches. For exact matches, we may need to source specialty tiles.

faqs.question: Do you handle shower pan or major tile work?
faqs.answer: For extensive tile work, we partner with licensed tile contractors. We focus on repairs and maintenance that prevent bigger problems.

title: Deck & Fence Repair
shortDescription: Structural repairs, board replacement, and maintenance for decks and fences to ensure safety and extend their lifespan.
introduction: Our deck and fence repair services focus on safety, structural integrity, and extending the life of your outdoor structures. We handle everything from loose boards to railing repairs with quality materials built to last.
typicalProblems: Loose or rotting deck boards and railings
Wobbly fence posts and sagging gates
Loose or missing hardware and fasteners
ourApproach: Thorough structural assessment for safety
Quality lumber and galvanized hardware
Proper fastening techniques for longevity
Weather-resistant treatments and finishes
Code-compliant repairs and improvements

faqs.question: Can you match existing wood species and stain colors?
faqs.answer: Yes, we work to match existing materials as closely as possible and can recommend stains that blend well with weathered wood.

faqs.question: Do you handle major deck reconstruction?
faqs.answer: We focus on repairs and partial replacements. For complete deck rebuilds, we can recommend qualified deck contractors.

faqs.question: What's the best time of year for deck and fence repairs?
faqs.answer: Spring through fall offers the best weather conditions, but we can handle urgent repairs year-round.

title: Bathroom Refresh
shortDescription: Light bathroom remodeling including vanity installation, mirror mounting, and fixture upgrades for a fresh new look.
introduction: Our bathroom refresh services transform your space with strategic upgrades that make a big impact. From new vanities to updated fixtures, we handle the details that give your bathroom a fresh, modern feel without major renovation.
ourApproach: Space planning for optimal function and flow
Quality fixture selection and installation
Precise measurements for perfect fits
Coordinated finishes and color schemes
Professional mounting and secure installations

faqs.question: Can you work with fixtures I've already purchased?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We're experienced with most major brands and can ensure proper installation of your chosen fixtures.

faqs.question: Do you handle plumbing for new vanity installations?
faqs.answer: We handle basic plumbing connections. For complex plumbing changes, we work with licensed plumbers to ensure code compliance.

faqs.question: How long does a typical bathroom refresh take?
faqs.answer: Most refreshes take 1-3 days depending on the scope. We'll provide a detailed timeline during your consultation.
